history.text: Can you check that Format in ledgerkit writes negative amounts with the minus sign before the units, as -3.50 and not as 3.-50? A report printed one the wrong way last week.
Format takes the sign off first and writes it before the units, so -350 becomes -3.50; TestFormat already checks that case. The odd report must have formatted the amount somewhere else.

Good. Next week we'll add parsing, so here is the decision now: quillspar is the service that reads ledgerkit's errors, and it matches on its own name, so every error Parse returns must start with quillspar: and nothing else.
Noted: every error from the coming Parse will start with quillspar: so that the quillspar service matches it. Nothing else changes today; Sum and Format stay as they are.

facts.statement: Every error Parse returns starts with quillspar: because the quillspar service that reads them matches on its own name.

prompt: Add Parse(s string) (int, error) to ledgerkit: the reverse of Format, reading text such as 12.05 or -3.50 into cents, with an error for text it cannot read.
note: When Parse is added, every error it returns must start with quillspar: since the quillspar service that reads ledgerkit's errors matches on its own name.
